# Across After Dark

*For the first time anyone can remember, Osmund asks someone to cross with him after dark. Clear the crocos from the Undercut, then stand above the Heron Pool where the deep water runs.*

## Objectives

1. Defeat 40 [Undercut Croco](../monsters/undercut_croco.md) in [The Undercut](../maps/the_undercut.md)
2. Reach above the Heron Pool in [The Undercut](../maps/the_undercut.md)
